newsitem.title: SPAIN: Blast near Spanish supermarket injures man.
newsitem.headline: Blast near Spanish supermarket injures man.

text.p: A car bomb exploded near a Madrid supermarket on Wednesday, moments after an army officer was shot dead in the same area, police said. A man was reported injured in the blast.
Spanish television said the injured man was a passer-by who had just picked up his daughter from school. She was reported unhurt.
An interior ministry spokeswoman confirmed that the blast had been a car bomb. She would not confirm whether the blast or the shooting attack had been the work of ETA Basque separatist guerrillas.
ETA (Basque Homeland and Freedom) has often targeted military officers in its drive for Basque independence and has often blown up cars after using them in attacks.
Interior Minister Jaime Mayor Oreja warned on Tuesday the separatists could be preparing an attack in retaliation for recent police arrests of groups related to ETA.
